tools.name: set_device_state
tools.description: Set live UI state on the attached Android device or emulator through adb: dark mode, font scale, display density, forced RTL, layout bounds, animations. Answers the device state afterwards. Use before judging a screenshot under a configuration (for example dark + font 1.3 + RTL).

tools.name: run_worker
tools.description: Force-run a scheduled WorkManager/JobScheduler job of the app (`cmd jobscheduler run -f`, with `-n <namespace>` on API 34+ where WorkManager schedules in androidx.work.systemjobscheduler), ignoring its constraints. With no jobId it lists the app's jobs and runs the only one, or the one whose WorkSpec id matches. Job ids change each time work is enqueued; a gone id is re-resolved.

tools.name: set_doze
tools.description: Force the device into Doze deep idle ('idle', also unplugs the battery) or back out ('off'), and/or set the app standby bucket. Answers the Doze and bucket state afterwards.

children: None listed. Refresh after enqueueing work.
